original_value: Fictional compact desktop audio interface for podcasters and streamers, featuring a single XLR input, stereo line output, and USB-C connectivity. Designed for low-latency voice capture, it includes a gain control knob, direct monitoring, and a padded carry sleeve for mobile recording kits.
